description: This file defines the interface and class for a SmartBuffer utility that provides advanced buffer reading and writing capabilities, including methods for various data types and string handling. It contains type definitions, class declarations, and method signatures but no executable code.

classes.name: SmartBuffer
classes.description: A class providing methods for buffer manipulations such as reading and writing various data types, strings, and buffers with support for offsets, insertions, and capacity management.
